publicationStatus: macOS 0.3.1 fixes the wallpaper preview crash. Windows and Linux 0.3.0 remain available.

downloads.label: macOS universal (.dmg)
installInstructions: Open the disk image and drag Voltrum Motion to Applications.
This preview is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. If macOS blocks it, review the app in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
Open Motion and import your own local videos.

downloads.label: Windows x64 (.exe)
installInstructions: Run the downloaded installer and follow the setup prompts.
This preview is unsigned; Windows may show a publisher warning.
Open Motion and import your own images or videos.

downloads.label: Windows x64 (.zip)
installInstructions: Extract the entire ZIP into a folder you control.
Run Voltrum Motion.exe from the extracted folder.
This portable preview is unsigned.

downloads.label: Linux x64 (.AppImage)
downloads.minimumSystem: 64-bit Linux with X11 or supported wlroots Wayland
installInstructions: chmod +x Voltrum-Motion-0.3.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage
./Voltrum-Motion-0.3.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage
Requires Linux X11, or a supported wlroots Wayland compositor with mpvpaper. GNOME/KDE Wayland are not supported.

downloads.label: Linux x64 (.deb)
downloads.minimumSystem: 64-bit Linux with X11 or supported wlroots Wayland
installInstructions: sudo apt install ./Voltrum-Motion-0.3.0-linux-amd64.deb
Launch Voltrum Motion from your applications menu.
Requires X11, or supported wlroots Wayland with mpvpaper; GNOME/KDE Wayland are not supported.

downloads.label: Linux x64 (.rpm)
downloads.minimumSystem: 64-bit Linux with X11 or supported wlroots Wayland
installInstructions: sudo dnf install ./Voltrum-Motion-0.3.0-linux-x86_64.rpm
Launch Voltrum Motion from your applications menu.
Requires X11, or supported wlroots Wayland with mpvpaper; GNOME/KDE Wayland are not supported.

downloads.label: Linux x64 (.tar.gz)
downloads.minimumSystem: 64-bit Linux with X11 or supported wlroots Wayland
installInstructions: tar -xzf Voltrum-Motion-0.3.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
Run voltrum-motion from the extracted directory.
Requires X11, or supported wlroots Wayland with mpvpaper; GNOME/KDE Wayland are not supported.
